create table t_prof (a int not null, b int not null)
create materialized view log on t_prof (a, b) purge next date_add(now(), interval 1 hour)
create materialized view mv_prof (a, s, cnt) refresh fast next date_add(now(), interval 1 hour) as select a, sum(b), count(1) from t_prof group by a
update t_prof set b = 11 where a = 1 and b = 10
refresh materialized view mv_prof fast with profile
